auth.tagline: Your personal veterinary assistant for your pets
auth.privacy: Your pets' data, appointments and reminders are visible only to you. The password is stored as a bcrypt hash.

accessRequest.title: Request access
accessRequest.subtitle: The service is invite-only. Tell us who you are and why you need access.
accessRequest.reasonPlaceholder: For example: a veterinarian who wants to test the service
accessRequest.fillFields: Fill in the email and reason.
accessRequest.sent: Request sent. We will contact you after approval

composer.placeholder: Describe what is bothering your pet…
composer.disclaimer: VetAssistant is an AI, not a live veterinarian. In case of emergency symptoms, contact a clinic immediately.
composer.hint: Enter or Ctrl+Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line.

welcome.title: How can I help your pet?
welcome.description: Describe the symptoms or ask a question. I rely on the MSD Vet Manual knowledge base, remember the conversation context and can book an appointment for your pet.
welcome.disclaimer: The assistant does not make a final diagnosis and does not replace a doctor's examination. In case of difficulty breathing, seizures or poisoning, go to a clinic immediately.
